description: Four two-input select gates under common control: KA and KB together choose whether each output follows its A input, its B input, the two ORed together, or neither.

inputs.text: One of that gate's two inputs; it reaches the output only while KA is high.
One of that gate's two inputs; it reaches the output only while KB is high.
Take this high to let the A inputs through to the outputs; it acts on all four gates at once.
Take this high to let the B inputs through to the outputs; it acts on all four gates at once.

outputs.text: 10V while a selected input of that gate is high; with both KA and KB low it stays at 0V whatever the inputs do.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
With nothing patched into KA and KB both count as low and all four outputs stay at 0V, so the module does nothing until one of them is taken high.
The three STATUS lamps mark which selection is in force: A, B, or A+B with both taken high.
